title: Zakat
intro: An estimate of the zakat on your trade goods: the figures the software knows, plus what you add, against the nisab you enter.

nisabCard.title: Nisab of the year
nisabCard.help: Enter the nisab the Ministry of Religious Affairs publishes for the current Hijri year. The software never fills it in: the calculation uses only the figure you type. Update it each new Hijri year.
nisabCard.sourceHint: For your records, for example “Ministry of Religious Affairs, 1447”.
nisabCard.ownerOnly: Only a user allowed to change the shop's settings can enter the nisab.
nisabCard.mainPcOnly: The nisab is entered on the main PC.

nisabMissing.title: Enter the nisab first
nisabMissing.body: The calculation starts once the nisab of the current Hijri year is entered in “Nisab of the year”.

belowNisab: The base is below the nisab: no zakat is due.
disclaimer: An indicative calculation made by the software. It is not a fatwa; when in doubt, ask a scholar or your wilaya's religious affairs directorate.
savedEmpty: No saved calculation. Save today's to keep and print it.
printed: Zakat calculation sent to the printer.
mainPcOnly: Calculations are saved and kept on the main PC.
